paragraphs.text: You can book a practical driving test once you have passed the theory test. The theory test certificate is valid for two years, so you must pass the practical test within that time.
Tests can be booked online up to 24 weeks in advance. You will need your driving licence number and your theory test certificate number to complete the booking.
The standard fee for a weekday test is £62. Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75.
On the day of the test, arrive at the test centre at least 10 minutes early and bring your licence. If you use your own car, it must have an extra mirror for the examiner.

If you need to change or cancel your test, give at least three working days’ notice, or you will lose the fee. Results are given at the end of the test, and successful candidates receive their certificate on the same day.

items.quote: once you have passed the theory test
items.prompt: Which test must learners pass before booking a practical test?

explanation.en: “once you have passed the theory test” → theory test. “Practical” is the test being booked.
explanation.kk: «once you have passed the theory test» → theory test. «Practical» — дәл брондалатын емтихан.
explanation.ru: «once you have passed the theory test» → theory test. «Practical» — это как раз тест, который бронируют.

items.quote: The theory test certificate is valid for two years
items.prompt: For how long is the theory test certificate valid?

explanation.en: “valid for two years” → two years. 24 weeks is how far ahead you can book.
explanation.kk: «valid for two years» → two years. 24 weeks — қаншалықты алдын ала брондалатыны.
explanation.ru: «valid for two years» → two years. 24 weeks — насколько заранее бронируют.

items.quote: Tests can be booked online up to 24 weeks in advance
items.prompt: How far ahead can a test be booked online?

explanation.en: Tests can be booked online “up to 24 weeks in advance”. “How far ahead” means “in advance”, so the answer is 24 weeks.
explanation.kk: Емтиханды онлайн «up to 24 weeks in advance» брондауға болады. Сұрақтағы «how far ahead» — «in advance» дегені, жауап 24 weeks.
explanation.ru: Онлайн тест можно забронировать «up to 24 weeks in advance». «How far ahead» в вопросе значит «in advance», ответ 24 weeks.

items.quote: Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75
items.prompt: How much does a test at the weekend cost?

explanation.en: Weekend tests cost more: “Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75” → £75. £62 is the weekday price.
explanation.kk: Демалыс күні емтихан қымбатырақ: «Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75» → £75. £62 — жұмыс күнінің бағасы.
explanation.ru: В выходные тест стоит дороже: «Tests on evenings, weekends and public holidays cost £75» → £75. £62 — цена в будний день.

items.quote: it must have an extra mirror for the examiner
items.prompt: What extra item must a learner’s own car have?

explanation.en: “it must have an extra mirror for the examiner” → extra mirror (“mirror” is also accepted).
explanation.kk: «it must have an extra mirror for the examiner» → extra mirror (mirror да есептеледі).
explanation.ru: «it must have an extra mirror for the examiner» → extra mirror (засчитывается и mirror).
